paper_title: Early-Universe Simulations of the Cosmological Axion
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs m_a in eV
notes: This paper presents cosmological simulations determining the QCD axion mass that yields the correct DM relic abundance (m_a = 25.2 ± 11.0 μeV, corresponding to f_a = (2.27±0.33)e11 GeV). It is a preferred-value determination, not an exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on a coupling. The main result (Fig. 4) plots relic abundance Omega_a vs f_a, not a coupling exclusion. No (mass, coupling) exclusion data points are extractable.
